facts.fact: Kit 已在 Soren 右手边的固定座位吃了五个月早餐。
facts.anchor: I’ve been sitting in this exact chair to Soren’s right for five whole months. Every single morning.

facts.fact: 新来的 Aria 一进餐厅就俯身把 Kit 抱进怀里。
facts.anchor: Before I can shrink any further, she leans over and pulls me into a warm, easy hug.

facts.fact: Soren 到场后命令 Aria 松手让位，说这里不许人和 Kit 说话或碰他。
facts.anchor: They don’t speak to him or touch him because they’re not allowed. I suggest if you want a place here you respect that and move.

facts.fact: Kit 觉得 Aria 才来五分钟就已比他更融入这个家。
facts.anchor: She’s been here five minutes and already belongs more than I ever have.

facts.fact: Kit 摇头拒绝坐下，推门离开餐厅并故意把门摔上。
facts.anchor: I shake my head without looking back and push through the doors, letting them slam shut behind me on purpose.

facts.fact: Kit 心里说自己被关在这栋房子里十个月，只获准和 Lorraine 一个人说话。
facts.anchor: I’ve been trapped in this house for ten months with permission to speak to exactly one person: Lorraine.

facts.fact: Soren 追上 Kit，一臂拦腰把他整个人扛到肩上。
facts.anchor: A powerful arm hooks around my waist and I’m suddenly airborne, thrown over his shoulder like I weigh nothing.

facts.fact: Kit 控诉说五天前的周一自己刚满二十一岁，父母本会大张旗鼓庆祝。
facts.anchor: I was twenty-one five days ago, on Monday. My parents would have made a fuss.
